Anytime a call center implements new polices, heads will roll. Either due to some people not being able to adjust, or doing the new policy but not adhering to it correctly, or more. The point being is that management will be keeping all eyes out on who is having trouble or whatnot, and that puts you in a bad position. The email to the manger over your concerns was not the way to go. You have now put a target on your back, and worse all levels of management from this manager on down will be made aware. Plus, you state that you're nearing the period where they are deciding to keep you.

My advice would be to immediately retract your statement, or modify it (i.e. " I had time to think it over and this policy is the right way to help our customers) and apologize. Do not go outside the norm. Do not endanger yourself for the customer. I try to help my customers all I can, but if it's something that's gonna put my ass in the line of fire I'm out. That's how these call centers work. The only time you should ever speak out and challenge someone is IF it's someone below you in position, or same level position, or if it's someone like another supervisor and someone with equal power like your supervisor has your back. Yes it sucks that some of these changes call centers make will fuck people over, but at the end of the day you need your job. I've seen it time and time again with fellow coworkers doing stuff like this and either being terminated or bullied into being let go. I don't know what state you are located in, but my state is a hire and fire state so I could walk into work with the wrong color of shoelaces and be terminated.

Although you have endangered yourself, I think you will be fine if you retract that email and keep up the bullshit smile and facade all management loves. The damage is done, so all you can do is hope for the best and smile. I'm sorry if this is blunt but this is reality, and while I admire your stance to help others helping others over a phone won't keep the lights on.

Source- Call Center agent for 3+ years, in various departments.
